how: Opened the public Perplexity session page and selected the answer body (tables and some math) with a DOM range, then ran document.execCommand("copy").
notes: Perplexity session page selection: 4 tables, block math as <span class="katex-display"> with <annotation encoding="application/x-tex"> present, utility-class (Tailwind) markup with escaped brackets in class names. No copy-button capture (button writes nothing headless).
